notes.text: נב: gives Pesachim 52b and י. gives Berakhot 10a by the colon/period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Chama and Shimi remain separate attestations; shared patronymics do not establish one father. The earlier machine column’s different following material leaves a source-boundary question outside this translation. The heading has no title; both Rav titles in the body are full.
